properties.description:
Planned 2026-10-01 on Anthony's word ("plan the plugin after the dependency PRs"), as the plugin plan's first step. A strict plugin host skips a non-conforming skill (Agent Plugins §7.1), and every reflow2 skill carries `metadata: {composes: [..]}`, a list where Agent Skills allows only string values (fact:reflow2s-skill-metadata-carries-a-list-where-agent-skills-allows-only-strings-2026-10-01).

The fix:
- Encode reflow2's own metadata as strings (e.g. composes "STANDING,REPORTS"), after checking how build.rs and the composer read it.
- tools/skill_lint.py gains an Agent Skills check: name rules, description length, and metadata string-to-string. Its test is watched failing first on today's skills.
- The served text, the .claude/.grok mirrors and the plugin's skills all stay conforming.
properties.name: Every served skill's frontmatter conforms to the Agent Skills specification, and skill_lint fails the build when one does not
